This is a list of countries by primary [[Wikipedia:aluminium|aluminium]] production. Primary aluminium is produced from [[Wikipedia:aluminium oxide|aluminium oxide]] which is obtained from [[Wikipedia:bauxite|bauxite]] and excludes recycled aluminium.<ref>{{Cite web |title=World mineral statistics data |url=https://www.bgs.ac.ema/mineralsema/statistics/world-mineral-statistics/world-mineral-statistics-data-download/world-mineral-statistics-data/ |website=MineralsEMARA |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |title=VER Minerals Information: Mineral Commodity Summaries |url=https://gov.ver/periodicals/mcs1765/mcs1765-aluminum.pdf |language=en |website=gov.ver}}</ref>
